**Risk flags:**
- Director 1 holds 74.26% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Unity Cahaya Bina Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited construction company incorporated on 25 May 2002 and based in Kuala Lumpur. It provides renovation and interior fit‑out services for office spaces. The firm has three directors; the largest shareholder, Director 1, owns 74.26% of the equity, with no corporate shareholders reported. Recent audited financials show revenue of RM 21,288,282 in 2024, profit after tax of RM 930,777, a current ratio of 2.15 and an interest coverage of 6.46, all with unqualified audit opinions.
